prompt: Explain, in three sentences, why a spinning bicycle wheel is harder to tip over than a stationary one.
A recipe serves four people and calls for 300 g of rice. Rewrite the rice quantity for seven people and show the arithmetic.
Summarise the difference between a stack and a queue for someone who has never written code.
Write a polite three-line email declining a meeting invitation and proposing two alternative times.
A train leaves at 14:35 and the journey takes 2 hours 50 minutes. State the arrival time and explain the carry.
Name two reasons a bridge might be built as a suspension bridge rather than a simple beam bridge.
Rewrite this sentence in the active voice: 'The proposal was rejected by the committee after a long discussion.'
Explain what a database index does, and name one cost of adding one.
A shop marks a coat up by 40% and then discounts it by 40%. Is the final price above, below, or equal to the original? Justify it.
Describe how you would test whether a new website button is easier to find than the old one.
In two sentences, explain why saltwater freezes at a lower temperature than fresh water.
Convert this instruction into a numbered checklist: 'Back up the database, apply the migration, restart the workers, then verify the queue is draining.'
A room is 4.2 m by 3.5 m. Tiles are 30 cm square. How many tiles are needed, ignoring cuts? Show the working.
Explain the difference between correlation and causation using an everyday example that is not about ice cream.
Write a one-paragraph changelog entry for a release that fixes a crash on startup and adds dark mode.
Why does a heavier vehicle need a longer braking distance at the same speed? Answer in two sentences.
Given the list [7, 3, 9, 3, 1], describe step by step how insertion sort would order it ascending.
Explain to a new colleague what a code review is for, and name one thing it is not for.
A bank account earns 3% simple interest a year on 1,200 units. State the balance after four years and show the arithmetic.
Describe two ways a city can reduce rush-hour congestion without building new roads.
Rewrite this error message so a non-technical user can act on it: 'ERR_CONN_RESET: upstream closed the socket.'
Explain why a compressed archive of random bytes is usually no smaller than the original.
A recipe says 'bake 25 minutes at 200 C, or until golden'. Explain why both a time and a visual cue are given.
List three questions you would ask before agreeing to migrate a service to a new database engine.
Explain what happens to the pitch of a siren as an ambulance passes you, and why.
Turn this requirement into two testable acceptance criteria: 'Users should be able to reset their password easily.'
A cyclist rides 12 km at 24 km/h, then 8 km at 16 km/h. Compute the average speed for the whole ride and show the working.
Explain in plain language what a certificate authority does when you visit a secure website.
Give two reasons a team might keep a slow but readable implementation instead of a fast but cryptic one.
Explain why bread dough rises, and what stops it rising further in the oven.
A survey of 200 people finds 150 prefer option A. State the proportion, and one reason the result may not generalise.
Describe the difference between a backup and a replica, and when each one saves you.

Rewrite this paragraph at half the length without losing any fact: 'The service was unavailable for eleven minutes on Tuesday morning because a configuration change removed a required environment variable, which caused every new worker to exit during startup until the change was reverted.'
Explain why adding more people to a late software project often makes it later.
A tank holds 90 litres and drains at 1.5 litres per minute while filling at 0.9 litres per minute. How long until it is empty? Show the working.
Explain what a unit of electricity on a household bill measures, and name one appliance that uses a lot of it.
Write three bullet points a manager could read in ten seconds summarising a week spent fixing flaky tests.
Explain why two thermometers in the same room can disagree by a degree, and how you would decide which to trust.
Given a log line 'level=warn msg="retrying" attempt=4 backoff=8s', explain what the system is doing and whether it is healthy.
Explain the trade-off between checking in a lock file and letting dependency versions float.
